key_findings: Ripple announced a broad institutional stack: Ripple Treasury, 24/7 Returns, Ripple Prime, payments, custody, RLUSD, XRPL tokenized money-market funds, BNY/C2FO trade finance and Privy programmable-wallet payments.

Ripple's $900M annualized product revenue run rate, $16T transactions enabled in 2025, 85 licenses, 1,700+ institutions, 60+ payout markets and $150B lifetime volume target are company-reported ecosystem metrics, not XRP-specific volume.
RLUSD is described by Ripple as facilitating onchain repo markets; Ripple Prime provides financing/clearing. No source in this run establishes XRP as Ripple Prime collateral.
BNY/C2FO tokenized supplier finance on XRPL and Privy wallet payments with XRP/RLUSD are institutional adoption signals, but product-level volumes are undisclosed.
FOMC held 3.75%-4.00% on October 28 by 10-2; both dissenters preferred a 25bp increase. Treasury October 30 yields were 4.16% 3m, 4.56% 2y, 4.94% 10y and 5.31% 30y; SOFR was 3.94% on October 28.
High short rates can support stablecoin reserve income while increasing opportunity cost for non-yielding XRP; this is a plausible but ambiguous macro channel, not a forecast.
